conditions.displayName: More than 5 terminal generation failures in an hour

documentation.content: More than 5 generations ended in a terminal failure in the last hour. Count them by reason from a laptop with `node server/admin.mjs usage --days 1`, then read the lines in Logs Explorer: `resource.type="cloud_run_revision" resource.labels.service_name="whim-server" jsonPayload.msg="terminal failure"` (docs/deploy.md, Operating: Alerts).
